capabilities: Detect incomplete files using built-in rules (empty content, empty headings, incomplete syntax)
Mark incomplete notes with an inline %% INCOMPLETE %% syntax
List all incomplete files in a dedicated view with last update time
Update the incomplete file list in realtime as notes change
extras: The README contains typos (e.g. 'EMTPY CONTENT', 'treaded') and ends with a request for GitHub sponsorship or coffee donations; installation can also be done via BRAT or manual git clone.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to find notes that are still unfinished, such as empty files or headings without content.
summary: Rule-based tracker that flags incomplete notes and lists them in a view with issues and last update time.
